name_zh: 亚美尼亚·提格兰大帝：帝国与罗马帕提亚博弈
name_en: Armenia Tigranes the Great: Empire & Rome Parthia Game
description_zh: 提格兰二世 (公元前95-前55) 亚美尼亚大帝，建立从里海到地中海的亚美尼亚帝国，在罗马与帕提亚两大帝国夹缝中通过外交与战争维持独立，推行希腊化文化融合政策。
description_en: Tigranes II (95-55 BC) Armenian Great King, built Armenian Empire from Caspian to Mediterranean, maintained independence between Rome and Parthia through diplomacy and war, promoted Hellenistic cultural fusion policy.
reason_zh: 提格兰大帝代表亚美尼亚历史上的帝国巅峰，展示了小国在大国博弈中通过外交平衡与文化融合生存发展的智慧，是高加索地区帝国建构的典范。
reason_en: Tigranes the Great represents the imperial peak of Armenian history, demonstrating wisdom of small state survival through diplomatic balance and cultural fusion amid great power competition, a model of imperial construction in the Caucasus.
steps_zh: 研究提格兰大帝早年被帕提亚扣押与继位
分析其向西扩张吞并叙利亚腓尼基与迦基琉
探讨与米特拉达梯六世联姻对抗罗马
评估公元前69年蒂格拉诺采塔战役罗马卢库卢斯入侵
总结提格兰帝国在罗马帕提亚夹缝中的外交生存智慧
steps_en: Study Tigranes early Parthian hostage experience and accession
Analyze westward expansion annexing Syria Phoenicia and Cilicia
Explore marriage alliance with Mithridates VI against Rome
Evaluate 69 BC Battle of Tigranocerta Roman Lucullus invasion
Summarize Tigranes empire diplomatic survival wisdom between Rome Parthia
expected_zh: 掌握提格兰大帝帝国建构与外交平衡策略，理解高加索小国在罗马帕提亚夹缝中的生存智慧，评估其对后世亚美尼亚民族认同的历史影响。
expected_en: Master Tigranes imperial construction and diplomatic balance strategy, understand Caucasus small state survival wisdom between Rome Parthia, evaluate its historical impact on later Armenian national identity.
case_zh: 公元前83年提格兰加冕亚美尼亚国王；公元前83-69年帝国扩张至地中海；公元前69年蒂格拉诺采塔战败；公元前66年向庞培投降保留核心领土。帝国外交平衡智慧永存。
case_en: 83 BC Tigranes crowned Armenian King; 83-69 BC empire expanded to Mediterranean; 69 BC Tigranocerta defeat; 66 BC surrendered to Pompey retaining core territory. Imperial diplomatic balance wisdom endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Armenian imperial peak; Rome-Parthia diplomatic balance; Hellenistic cultural fusion
